name: LEGO Ice Age
author: Athanas7a
description:
A microgame for all LEGO fans! 

The ice age is all around LEGO-land, surrounding with snow and ice everything! In this 3D platformer game you have to collect all the plants in 2 minutes to bring spring back!
Have fun!

Controls: Use WASD for direction, Space to jump and the mouse to rotate the camera view!

Game made for LEGO Ideas contest with username: Artanasia
